# MedSupply

> > MedSupply is a comprehensive medical supply distributor offering sterile injection equipment, wound care products, PPE, and healthcare essentials for clinical and home use.

MedSupply provides bulk wholesale and individual medical supplies from trusted brands including PrecisionGlide, Monoject, Curity, Cardinal Health, and Halyard. The catalog spans injection equipment (hypodermic needles, blunt cannulas), wound care (gauze, bandages, dressings), personal protective equipment (ASTM-rated masks, AAMI Level 3 isolation gowns), and mobility aids.

## Key Topics

- PrecisionGlide hypodermic needles
- Monoject injection equipment
- Curity wound care products
- AAMI Level 3 isolation gowns
- ASTM Level 1 and Level 3 masks
- Cardinal Health PPE
- Halyard protective equipment
- Luer lock systems
- Sterile medical supplies
- Latex-free products
- Bulk wholesale medical supplies
- Sharps disposal containers
- ReliaMed dressing products
- 27-gauge needles
- Breathable bandages and compression wraps
